sources.title: Scalable Data-Driven Reachability Analysis and Control via Koopman Operators with Conformal Coverage Guarantees
sources.review_notes: All 28 pages of arXiv:2601.01076v1 (L4DC 2026 / PMLR style) compared with 170 dpi renders and higher-resolution crops of every display, statement, table, figure and the algorithm, and with the authors' TeX source. Corrected: glyph-soup mathematics with <sup> and strikethrough markers rewritten in LaTeX from the macro-expanded TeX (471 snippets identical to the source), 17 extractor formula images replaced by LaTeX displays (22 display blocks in all), merged items split (Problems 1-2, contribution list, Section 6 run-in paragraphs, displays with swallowed prose), heading levels and small-caps appendix headings fixed, Figure 2 (classified as a table with leaked latexit strings) and Algorithm 1 (four fragments) rebuilt as crops, Table 1 cells rewritten, real compounds broken at line ends restored, bibliography (40 entries) cleaned of <u> tags with two compounds and one diacritic repaired. Furniture omitted: banner, arXiv stamp, running headers, page numbers. Appendix figures moved to their subsections with reading_order. Source slips are kept and listed in the conversion notes.

navigation.heading: Abstract

navigation.heading: 1. Introduction
navigation.purpose: Motivation (limits of nonlinear, data-driven and Koopman reachability), the name ScaRe-Kro, and the four contributions

navigation.heading: 2. Related Work
navigation.purpose: Run-in paragraphs on reachability via linear relaxation (NNV, CROWN), Koopman/Carleman reachability, and data-driven reachability

navigation.heading: 3. Preliminaries
navigation.purpose: System model (1a)/(1b), interval, ball and sequence notation; Koopman operators and the autoencoder lifting; NNV with Proposition 1 (CG Robustness); exact reachable set and RSOA; split conformal prediction

navigation.heading: 4. Problem Statement
navigation.purpose: Planner, initial-state perturbation, the high-probability RSOA target; Problem 1 (model learning and controller design) and Problem 2 ((1 - delta)-confident RSOA)

navigation.heading: 5. Methodology
navigation.purpose: One-paragraph roadmap of Sections 5.1-5.4 (Fig. 2, Alg. 1)

navigation.heading: 5.1. Koopman Operator Training
navigation.purpose: Composite training loss (reconstruction, latent consistency, multi-step prediction), initialisation and activations

navigation.heading: 5.2. Koopman Tracking LQR Design
navigation.purpose: Feedforward control (2), lifted error dynamics, finite-horizon LQR and the tracking laws (3)-(4)

navigation.heading: 5.3. Reachability Analysis for Closed-Loop Koopman Dynamics
navigation.purpose: TKFL computational graph, decoded closed-loop rollout (5)-(6), construction of the CG, the KRS optimisation (7), Lemma 1; Figure 2 (block diagram) at the end

navigation.heading: 5.4. Conformalizing Koopman Reachable Sets
navigation.purpose: Calibration data and rollouts (8)-(9), normalised SNSA score, quantile and error bounds, CP coverage display, Theorem 1 with the CKRS (10), Offline Calibration paragraph and runtime use

navigation.heading: 6. Experiments
navigation.purpose: Metrics, Baselines, the four baseline comparisons (learned reachability, pure CP with Figure 3, hybrid CP+NNV, pure NNV), Table 1, and per-system paragraphs (unicycle, planar and 3D quadcopter with Figure 4, MuJoCo hopper and swimmer)

navigation.heading: 7. Conclusion
navigation.purpose: Summary and two directions of future work
